python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

cls_8b = [90.48, 89.37, 88.31]
cwm_8b = [87.67, 86.98, 86.24]
diffs = [c - w for c, w in zip(cls_8b, cwm_8b)]
mean_diff = np.mean(diffs)
se = np.std(diffs, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(diffs))
t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_rel(cls_8b, cwm_8b)
cohens_d = mean_diff / np.std(diffs, ddof=1)

# Bootstrap CI
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
boot_diffs = []
for _ in range(10000):
    idx = rng.choice(len(diffs), size=len(diffs), replace=True)
    boot_diffs.append(np.mean([diffs[i] for i in idx]))
ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boot_diffs, [2.5, 97.5])

print('=== 8B CLS vs CWM (3 seeds, correct values) ===')
print()
print('Per-seed gaps:', [round(d, 2) for d in diffs])
print(f'Mean gap: {mean_diff:.3f}pp')
print(f'SD: {np.std(diffs, ddof=1):.3f}pp')
print(f'SE: {se:.3f}pp')
print()
print(f'Paired t: {t_stat:.2f}')
print(f'p (two-sided): {p_val:.4f}')
print(f'p (one-sided): {p_val/2:.4f}')
print(f\"Cohen's d: {cohens_d:.2f}\")
print(f'Bootstrap 95% CI: [{ci_lo:.2f}, {ci_hi:.2f}]')
print(f'P(gap > 0): {np.mean(np.array(boot_diffs) > 0):.4f}')
"
